decisions.reason: The enclosed manual laser workstation extends the core laser portfolio, is still listed on the website, and serves standard manual marking needs at low ongoing cost.
The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer is close to the core business, has its own page in both years, and drives recurring cartridge consumables revenue.
The piezo inkjet printer is a core high-resolution offering with its own page, and it supports the consumables and service business.
The industrial laser marking systems are featured on the home page as a flagship line and are central to the firm's Industry 4.0 traceability strategy.
The compact LC400 laser cabin was newly launched in 2024 with its own page, and it broadens the laser range for smaller applications.
The award-winning HR-Lube lubricant printing system opens a sheet metal niche with differentiation potential, although it is only mentioned on the website.
